about: WP32 inputs to implementation/review-ledger.json that git history cannot supply: files read in full during implementation and left unchanged, with the oracles that exercise them, and the environment lanes as recorded in implementation/validation.md. Regenerate the ledger with `npm run review:ledger`; `review-closure` checks it.

readUnchanged.note: boundary entry appended before the notice, leaf checked; the notice names the entry the session holds
sync and async unit commands bounded in time and output; async is show-only
observation parser: missing or malformed properties are unknown, never success
status view read bounded, no-follow; missing/unreadable/malformed/foreign/stale are unknown with reason
closed view codec; staleness is the reader's decision
fixed origin, caller authority dropped, placeholder swapped in headers and path, bounded concurrency, no resend, streamed
one request in flight, encoded-byte budgets both ways, deadlines
capabilities re-read at each use against incarnation, InvocationID, peer cgroup and pin
bounded no-follow reads; new/ is not yet delivered to the Principal's session; reading writes nothing
REQUEST_NOT_FOUND is distinct from a receipt; exit codes per state
